facts.value: The British Museum's Ashurbanipal Library Project admits that nobody fully understands what counted as the library, or how many there were.
facts.quote: We do not understand what constituted a library, how many there may have been
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/asbp/WhatistheLibrary/index.html' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'We do not understand what constituted a library, how many there may have been'

facts.value: The project describes Ashurbanipal's collection as the most significant library of antiquity until Alexandria.
facts.quote: Until the Library of Alexandria, it was the most significant library of antiquity
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/asbp/WhatistheLibrary/index.html' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'Until the Library of Alexandria, it was the most significant library of antiquity'

facts.value: Library tablets carry a colophon stating that they belonged to the palace of Ashurbanipal, usually with detail and a prayer.
facts.quote: These library colophons all contain a statement recording that they belonged to the palace of Ashurbanipal, usually followed by detailed information and a prayer
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/asbp/Colophons/index.html' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'all contain a statement recording that they belonged to the palace of Ashurbanipal'

facts.value: Layard's first dig at Nineveh was a private venture financed by Stratford Canning, the British ambassador in Constantinople.
facts.quote: Layard's excavations had begun as a private initiative financed by Stratford Canning, British Ambassador to the Ottoman Empire
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://oracc.museum.upenn.edu/asbp/RecordingtheLibrary/index.html' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'had begun as a private initiative financed by Stratford Canning'
